name: magpie
description: Magpie collects what every site can do, and composes those capabilities into reusable workflows.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run web:build && npm run demos:build
scripts.release: npm run build && rm -f magpie-extension.zip && (cd dist && zip -qr ../magpie-extension.zip .) && echo '[release] magpie-extension.zip — attach this to the GitHub release'
